name: Settings Page
description: Adds a Settings API page extending AbstractSettingsPage from rtcamp/wp-framework. Generates a page plus a worked example of register_setting() declarations.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the settings class. Default 'Inc\Settings' matches the rtCamp skeleton.
Directory for the settings file. Default 'includes/Settings'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Settings'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Settings'.
Page slug, lowercase, kebab- or snake-case, e.g. 'my-plugin-settings'.
PascalCase class name, derived from slug.
Sample option_name registered via register_setting(). Add more by editing get_settings().

wiring.description: Add the page to the Settings module so the framework Loader registers it on admin_menu and admin_init. If the Settings module does not exist yet, scaffold it first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=Settings --kind=settings-page`.
